[u][b]Interview with Eily - CV: Hanyuumi [/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39085879/74eb5f638a6e8e0e00899afe27cb4442aefd2116.png[/img]

1. Please introduce yourself.
This is Hanyu Umi. I mainly put out works for "adults".
Personally, I like the surname "Hanyu" because it has a cute sound.

2. Please tell me the appearance work
I think there are many games such as "Otogi Frontier" and "Lost Noah".
I also do situations such as "Mature woman earpick-neighbor's busty mature woman is my mom".

3. What is the biggest attraction of the character you were in charge of with GLASS?
Eily is a little unconfident in herself, but I like the feeling that she has a glimpse of some of the strong points, such as working hard on her work.

4. What steps do you take to increase your immersiveness when recording? 
At the time of recording, I am immersive or nervous, so I take my favorite milk-based drink to calm me down so that I can relax as much as possible. 

5. What if you would like to introduce a game that you recently enjoyed, a movie that you saw interesting, or an anime? 
I'm addicted to Hypnosismic lately. I'm enjoying the world of HIPHOP including rap ♪ Anime is also being broadcast and I laugh every week (lol) 

6. What type of cast do you want to play? 
I would like to try something like a little devil sister. I always have a relaxed attitude, but I also like characters that are clumsy or have a cute human touch.

7. Where would you like to travel when peace returns to the world?
I want to take the plunge and go abroad. I would like to see the streets of England and Europe. I think the cityscape at Christmas time seems to be fun ♪

8. What are your tips and hobbies that you would like to introduce in your recent life?
I have more opportunities to stay at home this year, so I'm addicted to muscle training and stretching that I can do during my time at home. After exercising, I feel refreshed and feel very good.

9. Is there anything memorable about this work?
Some of the staff members were present remotely for this recording, and it was a greeting through the camera. It was a little fresh ♪

10. Finally, a word to the users.
Thank you for playing "GLASS"!
Eily is a little unconfident, but I think she's cute too. There are other wonderful girls, so please love them all. Thank you for watching so far ♪
